title: How to organize the door, mat, and immediate floor | Entryway
description:
Catch grit, water and road salt at the threshold so none of it reaches the rest of the floors.

This is the Door, Mat, and Immediate Floor in the Entryway. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A coarse mat outside the door and an absorbent one inside, both lying dead flat with no curled corners, nothing whatsoever on the floor inside the door's swing, and a door that latches on the first push.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Nothing is stored on this patch of floor, so the recycling bag, the parcel waiting to go back and the sports k
Straighten: Two mats and only two.
Shine: Vacuum the inside mat on both faces, then take it outdoors, beat it and wash it.
Safety: A curled mat corner and a mat that slides on hard floor are the two ways this threshold puts somebody down.
Standardize: Run a thin line of tape around where the mat should sit, so a mat kicked out of position is obvious to anyone
Sustain: The mat is on your route back to the cupboard with the vacuum, so it gets done last, every time, as part of pu

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Nothing is stored on the floor inside the door's swing, ever, and both mats lie flat inside their taped outline.
